result.instructions: Tools for Crisp, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which conversations are unread right now, and who wrote them?"; "Show the last 20 messages of the conversation with the visitor from the pricing page."; "Reply to the open billing question with a short text and mark the conversation as unresolved.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Crisp data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run crisp_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run crisp_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run crisp_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. crisp_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: crisp_get_website
tools.title: Get website
tools.description: Get the Crisp website (workspace) this token is scoped to: its name, domain and settings. Good first call to confirm the connection. Crisp API: GET /v1/website/{website_id}.

tools.name: crisp_list_operators
tools.title: List operators
tools.description: List the operator members of the Crisp website (name, email, type). Use the user_id values to see who may answer. Crisp API: GET /v1/website/{website_id}/operators/list.

tools.name: crisp_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations of the website, newest activity first. Filter by unread, resolved or unresolved, or search text. Crisp API: GET /v1/website/{website_id}/conversations/{page}.

search_query.description: Free text to search in conversations (visitor name, email, message text).

filter_not_resolved.description: Only conversations that are not resolved.

tools.name: crisp_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation: its state (pending, unresolved or resolved), inbox, people id and timestamps. Crisp API: GET /v1/website/{website_id}/conversation/{session_id}.

session_id.description: The conversation session id, for example session_… (from crisp_list_conversations).

tools.name: crisp_get_conversation_meta
tools.title: Get conversation contact details
tools.description: Get the visitor details of a conversation: nickname, email, phone, address, subject, origin and connection info. Crisp API: GET /v1/website/{website_id}/conversation/{session_id}/meta.

session_id.description: The conversation session id, for example session_… (from crisp_list_conversations).

tools.name: crisp_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List the latest messages of a conversation. Page to older messages with timestamp_before, to newer ones with timestamp_after, or around a time with timestamp_around (Unix time in milliseconds). Crisp API: GET /v1/website/{website_id}/conversation/{session_id}/messages.

session_id.description: The conversation session id, for example session_… (from crisp_list_conversations).

timestamp_before.description: Return messages older than this Unix time in milliseconds.

timestamp_after.description: Return messages newer than this Unix time in milliseconds.

timestamp_around.description: Return messages around this Unix time in milliseconds.

tools.name: crisp_send_message
tools.title: Send operator message
tools.description: Send a message from an operator to the visitor of a conversation (type text), or add an internal note that the visitor does not see (type note). The visitor receives the text. Crisp API: POST /v1/website/{website_id}/conversation/{session_id}/message.

session_id.description: The conversation session id, for example session_… (from crisp_list_conversations).

type.description: text (default) reaches the visitor; note stays internal.

tools.name: crisp_set_conversation_state
tools.title: Set conversation state
tools.description: Set a conversation to pending, unresolved or resolved. Setting the same state twice has no further effect. Crisp API: PATCH /v1/website/{website_id}/conversation/{session_id}/state.

session_id.description: The conversation session id, for example session_… (from crisp_list_conversations).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Crisp
prompts.description: What you can do with Crisp here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: list_unread_and_unresolved_conversations
prompts.title: List unread and unresolved conversations
prompts.description: List conversations filtered by unread or unresolved state, or search them by text. Open one to read its state.

prompts.name: read_a_visitor_s_details_and_messages
prompts.title: Read a visitor's details and messages
prompts.description: Read the nickname, email and subject of a conversation's visitor. List its latest messages, or page back to older ones.

prompts.name: check_the_operators_of_a_website
prompts.title: Check the operators of a website
prompts.description: Read the website this token is scoped to. List its operators to see who can answer chats.

prompts.name: reply_to_a_visitor_and_set_the_state
prompts.title: Reply to a visitor and set the state
prompts.description: Read the latest messages first. Send an operator reply, which the visitor receives. Then set the conversation to pending, unresolved or resolved.

prompts.name: add_an_internal_note_to_a_conversation
prompts.title: Add an internal note to a conversation
prompts.description: Add a note that the visitor does not see. Use it to hand over context to a colleague.
